verifiedItems.explanation: SQL Server to MySQL is heterogeneous; AWS SCT converts schema and database code where supported; AWS DMS migrates data. Unsupported constructs need manual conversion.

Site-to-Site VPN can be provisioned without the lead time of Direct Connect. DMS full load plus CDC replicates ongoing changes, enabling low-downtime cutover after validating replication lag. CDC does not guarantee zero data loss by itself; pause source writes, drain changes, validate, then switch.

AWS Server Migration Service was discontinued in 2022. Both keyed answers use it; VM Import/Export does not provide continuous block-level replication. Modernize options to use AWS Transform MGN (formerly AWS Application Migration Service) for both servers, retaining continuous replication and cutover testing. Re-author choices before grading.
